items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: I knew Joe Jordan from Chicago here.

ctx.x: and me always was knowing that we were very soft on piano and I'd play on soft piano and you could just hardly hear him play and he could play every jazz technique that Joe and Louis and he was Louis.

items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: I knew Joe Jordan from Chicago here.

ctx.x: He could have been around there, but I didn't remember him. He was a fellow who came here to the Pekin Theater, I can't think now. Joe Jordan.
Joe Good Jordan, yeah. Do you know him? I know Joe Jordan. But I knew Joe Jordan from Chicago here. Here? Yeah, I knew Jordan from Chicago. I think he came from St. Louis. That's right.
